summary: Worthington Enterprises filed an 8-K under Items 2.02, 8.01 and 9.01 reporting fiscal 2027 first-quarter results for the period ended August 31, 2026, and separately announcing a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.20 per common share. The dividend was declared September 22, 2026, payable December 29, 2026 to holders of record as of December 15, 2026. No special-situation event, transaction or structural change is disclosed. The filing also includes a cautionary statement regarding forward-looking information. This is a routine earnings and dividend current report, not a special situation.
